ABCD
1SourcesUses
2LineUnitAmountDefinition
3
4Land$=LAND_COSTNamed input
5Acquisition costs$=LAND_COST*ACQ_COST_PCTLand times acquisition rate
6Land and acquisition$=C4+C5Funded at month 1
7Hard costs residential$=RES_GSF*HC_PSF_RESArea times unit rate
8Hard costs hotel$=HOTEL_GSF*HC_PSF_HOTELArea times unit rate
9Hard costs retail$=RETAIL_GSF*HC_PSF_RETAILArea times unit rate
10Hard costs$=C7+C8+C9Sum of hard-cost lines
11Contingency$=CONTINGENCY_PCT*C10Percent of hard costs
12Soft costs$=SOFTCOST_PCT*C10Percent of hard costs
13FF&E hotel$=HOTEL_KEYS*FFE_PER_KEYKeys times allowance
14FF&E retail$=RETAIL_GSF*FFE_PSF_RETAILArea times allowance
15FF&E$=C13+C14Hotel plus retail
16Developer fee base$=C6+C10+C11+C12+C15Land, acquisition, hard, contingency, soft, FF&E
17Developer fee$=DEVFEE_PCT*C16Percent of fee base
18Uses excluding interest$=C16+C17Fee base plus developer fee
19Average SOFR during construction%=AVERAGE(SOFR!$C$2:INDEX(SOFR!$C$2:$C$85,CONSTR_MONTHS))Arithmetic average of the paste-target forwards
20Interest reserve$=LTC_PCT*C18*((C19+CT_SPREAD_PCT)/12)*CONSTR_MONTHS*AVG_DRAWN_FRACLinear estimate. No circular interest calculation.
21Total uses$=(C18+C20)/(1-LTC_PCT*CT_COSTS_PCT)Closed form so commitment = LTC% x total uses, with loan costs inside uses.
22Construction commitment$=LTC_PCT*C21LTC times total uses, including the interest reserve
23Construction loan costs$=CT_COSTS_PCT*C22Percent of commitment. Permanent financing costs are not here.
24Uses component sum$=C18+C20+C23Ex-interest plus reserve plus loan costs
25Uses tie-out$=C24-C21Must be zero
26Sources
27Source: construction loan$=C22Commitment
28Source: equity$=C21-C22Total uses minus commitment. Contributed at month 1.
29Total sources$=C27+C28Loan plus equity
30GP equity$=C28*GP_EQUITY_PCTCo-invest share
31LP equity$=C28*(1-GP_EQUITY_PCT)Remainder of equity
32Non-land uses on the spend curve$=C10+C11+C12+C15+C17Hard, contingency, soft, FF&E, and fee
33Sources minus uses$=C29-C21Must be zero

9C5Closings by type equal inventory, and gross sellout equals unit prices plus parking plus storage, within $1=AND(ABS(SUM(CondoSellout!C4:CH4)-UNITS_STUDIO)<=1,ABS(SUM(CondoSellout!C5:CH5)-UNITS_1BR)<=1,ABS(SUM(CondoSellout!C6:CH6)-UNITS_2BR)<=1,ABS(SUM(CondoSellout!C7:CH7)-UNITS_3BR)<=1,ABS(SUM(CondoSellout!C8:CH8)-UNITS_PH)<=1,ABS(SUM(CondoSellout!C15:CH15)-(UNITS_STUDIO*SQFT_STUDIO*PPSF_STUDIO+UNITS_1BR*SQFT_1BR*PPSF_1BR+UNITS_2BR*SQFT_2BR*PPSF_2BR+UNITS_3BR*SQFT_3BR*PPSF_3BR+UNITS_PH*SQFT_PH*PPSF_PH+PARKING_SPACES*PARKING_PRICE+STORAGE_UNITS*STORAGE_PRICE))<=1)
10C6Hotel value equals exit T12 NOI over hotel cap, and retail value equals exit T12 NOI over retail cap, within $1=AND(ABS(HotelValuation!C7-HotelValuation!C6/HOTEL_CAP)<=1,ABS(RetailValuation!C7-RetailValuation!C6/RETAIL_CAP)<=1)
